info.title: SportsDesk & Fantasy402 Wire API (evidence-labelled)
info.description: Evidence model: every operation carries x-evidence.tier — A means a captured request and response are verified, B means observed first-party evidence (a captured request or a handler-verified route) without a captured response, C means inferred only with no capture, and D means a real surface missing from the spec; this release has no tier-A rows because no response body was ever captured (see docs/EVIDENCE.md).

post.summary: Manager getWebLog (mode B request observed; response not captured)
post.description: The forensic IP-investigation endpoint (operational_guardrails_runbook.md §5.1.1). Request side: a 2026-10-28 Manager HAR (portal v1.0.279) captured one mode-B POST with a form-urlencoded body and no Authorization header, so the session is cookie-based. Only mode B was captured; modes A, C and I are inferred from the portal form and still need a capture. Response side: no response body was captured, so the row schema is undocumented and none is published here. The WeblogEntry component (simulate_bettor_churn_suite.ts:117-123) records the four fields the old spec published, but a consumer type is not a capture, so it is not used as a response schema.

agentID.description: Session master agent; the captured value is redacted here.

customerID.description: 0 = whole book. Mode C should carry the target account (unverified).

start.description: Inclusive start date. Observed as MM/DD/YYYY in mode B; mode C reportedly sends YYYY-MM-DD (unverified).

end.description: Inclusive end date. Observed as MM/DD/YYYY in mode B; mode C reportedly sends YYYY-MM-DD (unverified).

type.description: A: web access log; B: global IP matcher; C: account IP match; I: users by IP. Only B was captured; A, C and I are inferred.

actions.description: Action filter. ALL was observed; other values are unobserved.

ip.description: Empty in the observed mode-B request; mode I should carry the IP or /24 prefix (unverified).

RRO.description: Observed as 1; the meaning is unknown.

agentOwner.description: Session master agent; the captured value is redacted here.

200.description: Response body was not captured; row schema undocumented

x-evidence.requiredCapture: Capture modes A, C and I requests (exact per-mode date format, ip value, target customerID) plus a full 200 response body for at least one mode, and record the auth actually accepted (session cookie vs Authorization header). Upgrades modes A/C/I from C and closes the response/auth contradiction.

post.summary: Manager getInfoPlayer (request observed; response not captured)
post.description: Read observed in the 2026-10-28 Manager HAR: opening a player sent a form POST with a 7-character trimmed customerID (e.g. CB112_1, not the padded 11-character form the old spec showed), and agentID/agentOwner were the logged-in master on all 19 Manager calls (operational_guardrails_runbook.md:213-214). get.description: Handler-defined contract: sportsdesk_webview_server.ts:114-131 returns the daemon's status, bound port/hostname, Bun-reported URL, timestamp, uptime, runtime and NODE_ENV. Verified against the handler source, not an HTTP capture. The daemon binds 0.0.0.0 by default (sportsdesk_webview_server.ts:9,345), so the example hostname is 0.0.0.0; the http://127.0.0.1:4020 server target is a loopback client view of that bind.

hostname.description: Bound hostname. Bun serves on all interfaces by default (0.0.0.0).

url.description: server.url as reported by Bun; with hostname 0.0.0.0 the daemon is reachable on all interfaces.

x-evidence.requiredCapture: Not a capture gap: reconcile the spec to sportsdesk_webview_server.ts:114-131 (add url + timestamp). A curl capture would only confirm the handler.

post.summary: Manager getHistory (wired settlement-history poll; no response capture)
post.description: The only upstream Fantasy402 route in this repository with a real fetch client: resolveHistoryPollUrl builds `${SPORTSDESK_PORTAL_HTTP_BASE}/cloud/api/Manager/getHistory` and pollManagerGetHistory POSTs with no request body (lib/fantasy402_settlement_ingest.ts:347-368). The response must be a JSON array or {data: []} or the poll throws (lib/fantasy402_settlement_ingest.ts:369-387). The request contract (agent scope, date window, auth) is therefore unknown, and row field shapes are not captured; tests/fixtures/fantasy402-history-poll.json is a placeholder shape sample. Surface: surface.manager-getHistory (tier D).

200.description: JSON array of raw settlement rows, or an object with a data array. Any other shape throws (lib/fantasy402_settlement_ingest.ts:374-387). Row fields are not captured, so only raw/unknown objects are described.

items.description: Raw settlement row; the poll types rows as Record<string, unknown> and no field shapes were captured.
Raw settlement row; field shapes not captured.

default.description: Non-2xx status is not captured; the poll throws on !res.ok (lib/fantasy402_settlement_ingest.ts:369-371).

x-evidence.requiredCapture: Capture one getHistory request/response (redacted) to record the upstream request contract (body/agent scope/date window/auth) and a real response body; this repo only proves the URL, the bodyless POST and the array-or-{data:[]} acceptance.

get.description: Serves customer-churn-simulation-dashboard.html as text/html (sportsdesk_webview_server.ts:134-141). The same handler also answers GET /; the root path is not modelled as an OpenAPI path because the ledger has no dedicated surface row for it. Surface: surface.daemon-dashboard (tier D).

200.description: Operator dashboard HTML with the daemon CORS/CSP headers.

schema.description: Static HTML document served from disk by the daemon.

x-evidence.requiredCapture: HTTP capture of the served /dashboard HTML (the route is handler-verified only; no HTTP response was captured).

fantasy402Cookie.name: session
fantasy402Cookie.description: Fantasy402 Manager portal session cookie. The 2026-10-28 capture carried no Authorization header and the session is cookie-based (operational_guardrails_runbook.md:153). The capture did not record the cookie name, so 'session' is a placeholder label, not a verified cookie name.

daemonBearer.description: Static daemon admin token: Authorization: Bearer <SPORTSDESK_ADMIN_TOKEN>, compared with crypto.timingSafeEqual (sportsdesk_webview_server.ts:27-47). The daemon answers 503 when SPORTSDESK_ADMIN_TOKEN is unset and 401 otherwise.

XRequestedWith.name: X-Requested-With
XRequestedWith.description: Observed on the captured 2026-10-28 mode-B Manager request. Whether the portal enforces it is unverified.

CSPHeader.description: Content-Security-Policy applied to daemon responses: frame-ancestors 'self' https://web.telegram.org https://*.telegram.org telegram: (sportsdesk_webview_server.ts:87-90).

Fantasy402SportCatalog.description: Fantasy402 desk navigation catalog (sub-sport lanes plus per-sport period menus). Reference metadata only, not an ingestion audit record. Surface: surface.fantasy402-sport-catalog (tier D). Parsed from fantasy402_sport_catalog.ts:41-54.

collisions.description: SSOT for scoped ingestion link_id keys (must match observed cross-sport codes).

expectedEmptySubSportPaths.description: Domain-correct structural empties (sport/code paths), not quality defects.

x-fixture.caveat: Committed SSOT sample, not a raw wire capture. capturedAt/periodsCapturedAt are fixture-declared.

SubSport.description: Sub-sport lane inside one sport (code plus display name). Parsed from fantasy402_sport_catalog.ts:8-11.

Period.description: Period menu entry for one sport; period 0 is named Game. Parsed from fantasy402_sport_catalog.ts:13-16.

SportEntry.description: Per-sport lane: the sub-sport tree plus the period menu. Parsed from fantasy402_sport_catalog.ts:18-22.

CollisionEntry.description: Desk-link code shared across sports (Arena, NCAA Extra). makeDeskLinkId rewrites these to <Sport>|<code>; the collision silently breaks scoped ingestion if it is not represented. Parsed from fantasy402_sport_catalog.ts:24-27.

ExpectedEmptySubSportPaths.description: Domain-correct structural empties (sport/code paths) split into stable and volatile LIVE surfaces; not quality defects. Parsed from fantasy402_sport_catalog.ts:29-32.

CatalogMigrationRisk.description: Migration hazard note attached to catalogue entries that need coordinated link_id migration. Parsed from fantasy402_sport_catalog.ts:34-39.

RawBetTickerTick.description: Consumer wire type for one bet-ticker row. Field names and number types only; this is a type declaration, not a captured response, so the getBetTicker operation (tier C) publishes no response schema. Parsed from simulate_bettor_churn_suite.ts:106-115.

TicketWriter.description: Wire value or free string. Known values: Internet | ALERT | GSLIVE | GSBUILDER | CSLEVEL2 | BLOCKED

RawPendingLeg.description: Consumer wire type for one pending wager leg. Risk and ToWin are cents and repeat identically across parlay legs. This is a type declaration, not a captured response; no pending-leg fixture or capture exists, so the getPending operation (tier C) publishes no response schema. Parsed from simulate_bettor_churn_suite.ts:91-104.

Risk.description: In cents (repeats identically across parlay legs)

ToWin.description: In cents (repeats identically across parlay legs)

ShortDesc.description: Sanitized first char gives true bet type

TicketWriter.description: Wire value or free string. Known values: Internet | ALERT | GSLIVE | GSBUILDER | CSLEVEL2 | BLOCKED

WeblogEntry.description: Consumer type that declares the four fields the old spec published as the getWebLog response row (customerID, ipAddress, timestamp, agentOwner). It is NOT used as a response schema here: the getWebLog response body was never captured (operational_guardrails_runbook.md:153), so the row schema remains undocumented. Parsed from simulate_bettor_churn_suite.ts:117-123.
